author: independent-spec-derived (subagent re-derivation under closed rule A, 2026-08-29)
notes: Re-derivation by an independent author EXCLUSIVELY from the frozen bundle (design.md Determinism Mechanism + Deterministic Interpretation Table + frozen fault corpus rows PC-1/PC-2; specs: determinism-rendering, pipeline-passes, clinical-fact-model) and the scenario inputs. No file under src/ was read; no implementation-generated golden document was read; no rendering code was executed. Input digests recomputed via shasum and equal to the committed scenario inputs. This re-derivation supersedes the 2026-08-29 first independent sample, which diverged from the implementation on exactly one glyph family (provenance), exposing spec silence A1. A1 CLOSED BY OWNER ADJUDICATION 2026-08-29 (option A, bracket form): provenance renders as [<source_kind> <source_ref>] with a single space separator inside square brackets (e.g. [monitor m-9], [clinical_note n-1]). With A1 closed, the full glyph rule set is closed and every former ambiguity is a recorded decision, none silently guessed: (A1, CLOSED) provenance bracket form above; (A2) uniform bracket grammar - present facts carry [present]; (A3) certainty renders NO glyph (R1: UNRESOLVED everywhere per CRC-001; source_kind informs PROVENANCE only per CRC-002 - no certainty token on the document surface); (A4) assessed absence token is 'missing' (line 'missing [missing]', with provenance - clinical-fact-model: assessed absence requires a source assertion); unassessed is 'unknown [not_assessed]' with NO provenance (frozen design.md PC-1 line 'FC: unknown [not_assessed]'); (A5) no header/mode banner - bare telegraphic lines only; (A6) numbers via shortest deterministic repr (str(int) for 72, '80.5' minimal information-preserving form, TA string '120/80' verbatim); (A7) the document renders every contract field exercised by the scenario family (FC, TA), ordered by codepoint sort on (field_id, clinical_fact_id); line grammar '{field}: {value} [{missingness}] [{provenance}]'; UTF-8, LF-only, no trailing whitespace, exactly one final newline. Path convention: input/document paths relative to tests/golden/, mirroring the parent manifest family shape.

scenarios.name: pc1_unassessed_fc
scenarios.notes: Exercises PC-1 (unassessed field renders explicit unknown). Derivation: input has only a TA fact (120/80, monitor m-9); FC has NO fact -> Deterministic Interpretation Table row 'No fact exists for the field' -> NOT_ASSESSED at document level -> frozen design.md line 'FC: unknown [not_assessed]', no provenance (nothing to trace - closed rule A4). TA fact-backed PRESENT -> closed rules A1+A2+A6 -> 'TA: 120/80 [present] [monitor m-9]' (provenance on every fact-backed line). Sort: codepoint (field_id, clinical_fact_id): FC < TA. No certainty glyph (A3). Bytes: ASCII/UTF-8, LF-only, no trailing whitespace, single final newline (od-verified).
